other_conditions: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Arunachal Pradesh
The applicant must be registered with the Labour Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB) and have an active membership at the time of application
The applicant must have a disease or have suffered an accident that required hospitalization or plastering at their residence
benefits_summary: Up to ₹15,000 for disability due to accident (₹2,000 for the first five days and ₹100 per additional day) and up to ₹25,000 depending on the percentage of disability.
